title: Retention mechanism, transfer device, handling robot system, and unloading device
abstract: To provide a retention mechanism, a transfer device, a handling robot system, and an unloading device that are capable of easily holding an article.SOLUTION: A retention mechanism includes: a base having one end, a structure connection mechanism, a drive part, and a regulation member. The structure connection mechanism includes a connection member for connecting at least two or more structures with the structure, and is rotatable in a first rotation direction about a first shaft, whereas partly restricted in rotation in a second rotation direction about the first shaft. The regulation member is provided at a prescribed distance from the one end. The drive part moves the structure connection mechanism in a first direction from the one end toward the regulation member. According to drive of the drive part, a projection part of the structure connection mechanism projecting beyond the one end projects in a second direction substantially orthogonal to the first direction after passing between the one end and the regulation member. The regulation member regulates movement of the projection part in the first direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Press-fitting device
abstract: To flexibly correspond to changes in press-fitting position.SOLUTION: A press-fitting device 1 has: a robot arm 21 capable of arranging a transmission case 90 gripped by a hand 4 at designated coordinates; a servo press machine 7 in which a press-fitting jig 72 to which a bearing 95 is mounted and a backup jig Bk are arranged to face each other on a common center line C7; and a slider 75 which is provided so as to be movable in a center line C7 direction, and in which the transmission case 90 gripped by the hand is positioned on the center line C7 when the slider is engaged with a part on the hand side. In the servo press machine 7, when the part on the hand 4 side engages with the slider 75, the slider 75 moves in the center line C7 direction, and the transmission case 90 gripped by the hand 4 is supported by the backup jig Bk. Subsequently, the press-fitting jig 72 is displaced in the center line C7 direction, and the bearing 95 is press-fitted into the transmission case 90 supported by the backup jig Bk.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Position holding mechanism and image forming apparatus
abstract: To prevent falling from a holding position.SOLUTION: A position holding mechanism comprises: a connection member 10 that is provided on any one of an outer door and an inner door and includes a slide hole 12; and a connection boss 4 that is provided on the other of the outer door and the inner door and is connected to the slide hole 12 to slide the slide hole 12 in association with rotation of the inner door with respect to the outer door. The slide hole 12 has, in communication with each other, a first wide part 12a, a second wide part 12c and a third wide part 12f in which the length in a width direction W orthogonal to a slide direction D2 in which the connection boss 4 slides is equal to or longer than the length d1 in the width direction W of the connection boss 4, a first narrow part 12b that is provided between the first wide part 12a and the second wide part 12c and is less than the length in the width direction W of the connection boss 4, and a second narrow part 12d that is provided between the second wide part 12c and the third wide part 12f and is less than the length in the width direction W of the connection boss 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Reel rack
abstract: To provide a reel rack capable of stably storing a reel body which a tape body for holding electronic component is wound.SOLUTION: A reel rack is provided with at least two support rods spaced apart, an edge of a reel body around which a tape body for holding an electronic component is wound is brought into contact with a contact portion on an outer circumference of each support rod so that reel body is place, a contact portion is provided with a static eliminator that removes static electricity from the reel body, and the static eliminator is provided so as to come into contact with the reel body and suppress misalignment in a longitudinal direction. Since the static eliminator can reliably contact an edge of the reel body to remove the static electricity and suppress a displacement of the reel body in the longitudinal direction, the reel body placed on the support rod is stable, and damage due to tipping can be reduced.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: connector
abstract: To realize an application to an inner housing in which a connector fitting direction is a die-cutting direction.SOLUTION: An inner housing 30 has a first holding part 33 protruding from each of a pair of side wall surfaces 32 and a pair of second holding parts 34 protruding from each of a pair of side wall surfaces without being disposed to face each of the first holding part in a connector insertion/extraction direction and an assembly direction. An outer housing member 50 has a sandwiched part 52 protruding from each of an inner wall surface 51a of a pair of side wall parts 51 and extending in the assembly direction and sandwiched between the first holding part and the pair of second holding parts for each of the side wall surfaces. The first holding part has a reference locking part 33a that locks a first locking part 52a of a clamped part to the reference position, the pair of second holding parts has a crushing rib 34a that is crushed by a second locking part 52b of the clamped part, and the first holding part and the pair of second holding parts clamp the clamped part by the reference locking part and the crushing rib.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Pyrazolyl derivatives useful as anti-cancer agents.
abstract: The present application provides a compound of formula (I) or a stereoisomer thereof, or an atropisomer thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of a stereoisomer thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of an atropisomer thereof; method for manufacturing said compound, and its therapeutic uses. The present application further provides a combination of pharmacologically active agents and a pharmaceutical composition comprising said compound.

title: Antagonist compounds.
abstract: The present invention relates to compounds of formula (I) shown below: wherein R<sub>1</sub>, R<sub>2</sub>, R<sub>3</sub>, R<sub>4</sub>, R<sub>5</sub> and R<sub>6</sub> are each as defined in the application. The present invention also relates to processes for the preparation of these compounds, to pharmaceutical compositions comprising them, and to their use in the treatment of diseases or conditions in which adenosine A2a and/or A2b receptor activity is implicated, such as, for example, cancer.

title: G9a inhibitors
abstract: To provide compounds for the treatment, prevention or suppression of various conditions (such as proliferative diseases like cancer, β-globinopathy, fibrosis, pain, neurodegenerative diseases, Prader-Willi syndrome, malaria, viral infections, myopathy, autism, etc.) by inhibiting G9a.SOLUTION: A compound represented by general formula (I) or a pharmacologically acceptable salt thereof is provided.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyridine derivatives, preparation method therefor and use thereof
abstract: A pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyridine derivative, and a preparation method and medical use thereof are provided. The pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyridine derivative shown in general formula (I), a preparation method of the derivative, a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of the derivative, and use of the derivative or salt as a therapeutic agent, especially as a rearranged during transfection (RET) inhibitor, are provided.

title: Irreversible fap inhibitor and use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of medicine, relates to an irreversible FAP inhibitor and a use thereof, and a use of the compound in a drug for diagnosing and/or treating tumors, rheumatoid arthritis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, atherosclerosis, myocardial infarction, liver fibrosis, pulmonary fibrosis, and renal fibrosis, and in particular to a compound represented by formula I, or an isomer thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt or metal complex thereof, and a use thereof. Substituents in formula I have the same definitions as those in the description.

title: Power Amplifier Circuit
abstract: To provide a power amplifier circuit that improves distortion characteristics and efficiency by forming a bypass path for high-frequency components.SOLUTION: A power amplifier circuit 101 comprises: a distribution circuit 41 that distributes an input signal RFin with a phase difference applied; a carrier amplifier 51 that outputs a first amplified signal RF4; a peak amplifier 52 that outputs a second amplified signal RF5; a combiner circuit 42 that combines the first amplified signal and the second amplified signal to generate a third amplified signal RFout; a first bias circuit 151 having a first bias supply terminal 151a that supplies a first bias to a second terminal of a first capacitor 61 through a resistor element 160; a second bias circuit 152 having a second bias supply terminal 152a that supplies a second bias to a second terminal of a second capacitor 62 through a resistor element 162; and a third capacitor 64 having the first terminal connected to the second capacitor 62 and the second terminal connected to the first bias supply terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Receiving module of transmission interface
abstract: A receiving module of a transmission interface is provided. The receiving module of the transmission interface includes an analog front-end (AFE) circuit and a track-and-hold circuit. The AFE circuit is used to receive an input signal to generate a first intermediate signal. The track-and-hold circuit is used to sample the first intermediate signal according to a first clock to generate a second intermediate signal, and comprises at least a first switch, at least a second switch, at least a first capacitor, and at least a second capacitor. The first switch and the second switch are turned on or off according to the first clock. The first capacitor has a first terminal and a second terminal, wherein the first terminal is coupled to the AFE circuit, and the second terminal receives a second clock. The second capacitor has a third terminal and a fourth terminal, wherein the third terminal is coupled to the AFE circuit, and the fourth terminal receives the second clock. The first clock and the second clock are inverse signals of each other.

title: Amplifier circuit and communication device
abstract: To provide an amplifier circuit in which the distortion of output characteristics of high-frequency signals is suppressed.SOLUTION: An amplifier circuit 1 includes an amplifying transistor 11 connected to a signal input terminal 110, a power supply circuit 22 configured to supply a bias voltage vg1a to the amplifying transistor 11, a resistor 32 arranged in series in a bias path connecting the power supply circuit 22 and the amplifying transistor 11, a transistor 21, which is connected to the bias path and power supply circuit 22 and used to simulate the amplifying transistor 11, and a detection diode 31 connected to a bias path between the resistor 32 and the gate of the amplifying transistor 11 and the signal input terminal 110.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Electronic device for shifting a voltage level
abstract: Electronic device for shifting a voltage level; the device comprising: a feedforward component configured for one-shot shifting a first voltage level of a first domain to a third voltage level of a third domain, wherein the third voltage level is different from the first voltage level, via at least one second voltage level of at least one second domain, wherein the at least one second voltage level is different from the first voltage level and from the third voltage level; and a feedback component configured for feeding back the third voltage level from the third domain to the at least one second domain.

title: Signal processing device
abstract: To provide a signal processing device capable of restricting its manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A signal processing device 1 is configured including: a signal processing part 2 at least having a first operational amplifier 41 and a second operational amplifier 42; a first switch 51 for changing the connection between a signal source and a first non-inverting input terminal 410, and between a reference voltage VCOM and the first non-inverting input terminal 410; a second switch 52 for changing the connection between the signal source and a second non-inverting input terminal 420 and between the reference voltage VCOM and the second non-inverting input terminal 420; and a control part 7 for defining an offset amount 72 of a first processing signal S5a based on a second processing signal S5b outputted from the signal processing part 2 by the connection of the reference voltage VCOM, the first non-inverting input terminal 410, and the second non-inverting input terminal 420, due to the changes of the first switch 51 and the second switch 52.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Fluid handling device, method for manufacturing the same, and method for introducing fluid medium into fluid handling device
abstract: To provide a fluid handling device that can fill not only a specific flow path but also a connection flow path with a fluid that branches off from it.SOLUTION: The fluid handling device of the present invention has a main flow path, a first flow path, and the first connection flow path that communicates the main flow path and the first flow path, the main flow path is a flow path into which a fluid A to be filled in the main flow path and the first connection flow path is introduced, and the Laplace pressure PL1 acting on the interface between the fluid A when the fluid A introduced into the main flow path is introduced from the main flow path into the first connection flow path and a fluid B prefilled in the first connection path satisfies condition 1. (Condition 1) PC>PL1 PC: Internal pressure at the branching portion of the main flow path and the connection flow path; and PL1: Laplace pressure when the dynamic contact angle θ of the fluid A introduced into the connection path from the main path with respect to the inner wall of the connection path is set to be less than π.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Two part assembly
abstract: A device that includes a first portion, the first portion including at least one fluid channel; a fluid actuator; and an introducer, a second portion, the second portion including at least one well, the well containing at least one material, wherein one of the first or second portion is moveable with respect to the other, wherein the introducer is configured to obtain at least a portion of the material from the at least one well and deliver it to the fluid channel, and wherein the fluid actuator is configured to move at least a portion of the material in the fluid channel.

title: Showerhead assemblies, semiconductor processing systems including showerhead assemblies and associated methods
abstract: To provide showerhead assemblies and semiconductor processing systems including showerhead assemblies, and related methods.SOLUTION: A showerhead assembly and a semiconductor processing system including the showerhead assembly are disclosed. The disclosed showerhead assembly includes a lid, a showerhead plate, and an annular flow ring disposed between the lid and the showerhead plate. There is a method for regulating gas flow to and from a reaction chamber when performing a process. The disclosed method includes positioning the annular flow ring at a first position and a second position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Plug
abstract: To provide a plug in which a flow rate can be easily adjusted, and which can discharge even a liquid of high viscosity in a short period of time.SOLUTION: A plug 10 which allows a liquid packaging container 1 to be opened/closed comprises: a spouting tube part 22 which is connected to the liquid packaging container 1; a spout 24 which is provided at a tip of the spouting tube part 22 to pour out content fluid of the liquid packaging container 1; and a plunger 31 which controls an opening of the spout 24 by advancing and retreating between a closing position and an opening position of the spout 24. An outline of a graphic form ABCD formed by projecting the spout 24 with respect to a virtual plane ZX including a center axis O of the plunger 31 is not formed in a circular shape, and includes at least four vertices where the curvature takes the maximum value. A first vertex A and a second vertex B among the vertices are aligned along a direction Z in which the plunger 31 moves back and forth. A fourth vertex D and a third vertex C among the vertices are positioned opposite to the first vertex A and the second vertex B in a manner where the center axis O is interposed, and aligned along the direction Z in which the plunger 31 moves back and forth.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Device and method
abstract: To reduce a fluid crosstalk in which pressure is transmitted to a pressure chamber.SOLUTION: A liquid discharge device includes: a passage member having a passage in which a pseudoplastic liquid flows; an actuator which applies a pressure to the liquid in the passage to cause droplets to be discharged from the passage member; and a passage sequentially circulating through a supply reservoir, a plurality of supply manifolds, a plurality of supply passages, a plurality of pressure chambers, a plurality of recovery passages, a plurality of recovery manifold, and a recovery reservoir. The passage has a passage shape such that an average viscosity of the liquid in the supply passages becomes a half of or lower than an average viscosity of the liquid in the supply manifolds when a circulation flow rate is a target flow rate to reduce fluid crosstalk.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title: Adaptation of spatial reuse for extremely high throughput
abstract: This disclosure describes systems, methods, and devices related to spatial reuse for extremely high throughput (EHT). A device may identify a frame received from a first station device configured to operate in a first basic service set (BSS) on a first channel. The device may analyze a preamble of the frame to determine a classification of the frame. The device may adjust a calculation of a packet detection for overlapping basic service set (OBSS) value based on a number of unpunctured 20 MHz frequency channels. The device may determine to simultaneously use the first channel for communication with a second device within a second BSS based on the calculation of the packet detection for OBSS value.

title: Method and apparatus for configuring communication using intelligent surface
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting a higher data transmission rate than a 4G communication system such as LTE. According to an embodiment of the present invention, disclosed may be a method for a base station which communicates with a UE through a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) in a wireless communication system, the method comprising the steps of: acquiring configuration information regarding the RIS through a pre-configuration; identifying to transmit a synchronization signal block (SSB) through the RIS; and repeatedly transmitting the same SSB for a time longer than or equal to the maximum period of the RIS.

title: User equipment
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method, user equipment, and a base station for implementing beam failure recovery within a random access procedure and contributing to automatic network optimization related to synchronization signal blocks and reference signals. SOLUTION: In a wireless communication system 10, user equipment 200 transmits beam failure-related information indicating the execution status of a random access procedure to a network NG-RAN 20. title: Systems and methods for ue processing
abstract: Presented are systems and methods for user equipment (UE) processing. A wireless communication device may receive a resource setting indicative of a plurality of sets of channel measurement reference signal (RS) resources (CMRs) from a wireless communication node. The wireless communication device can determine whether a plurality of conditions associated with the plurality of sets of CMRs is satisfied. The wireless communication device can determine whether to report measurement results.

title: Wireless Communication Device and Corresponding Apparatus, Method and Computer Program
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to wireless communication devices, systems comprising wireless communication devices, and to an apparatus, a method and a computer program for a wireless communication device. The apparatus comprises a transceiver module for transmitting and receiving wireless transmissions. The apparatus comprises a processing module that is configured to control the transceiver module. The processing module is configured to communicate with a further wireless communication device via the transceiver module. The communication with the further wireless communication device is based on a transmission of data frames between the wireless communication device and the further wireless communication device. Each data frame is based on a two-dimensional grid in a time-frequency plane having a time dimension resolution and a frequency dimension resolution. The processing module is configured to select a communication mode from a plurality of communication modes for the communication between the wireless communication device and the wireless communication device. The communication mode defines a combination of a frequency dimension resolution and a time dimension resolution of the two-dimensional grid in the time-frequency plane. The processing module is configured to negotiate a communication mode of the plurality of communication modes to select for a future communication between the wireless communication device and the further wireless communication device with the further wireless communication device.

title: Image formation apparatus
abstract: To provide an image formation apparatus which can suppress unauthorized use.SOLUTION: An image formation apparatus 1 comprises: an imaging unit 21; a storage unit 22; a collation unit 23; a determination unit 24; and a control unit 25. The imaging unit 21 acquires image data by imaging the peripheral scenery of the image formation apparatus 1. The storage unit 22 stores first registered image data registered by imaging the peripheral scenery of an installation schedule place of the image formation apparatus 1. The collation unit 23 collates the image data with the first registered image data to output first collation data. The determination unit 24 determines whether or not the image formation apparatus 1 is installed at the installation schedule place on the basis of the first collation data to output determination information. The control unit 25 drives a drive system of the image formation apparatus 1 on the basis of the determination information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Information providing system, provided information generating device, and information providing method
abstract: To simplify sorting work.SOLUTION: An information providing system includes an imaging device that images one or more objects to be sorted, a provided information generating device that generates sorting information, which is information for facilitating sorting work of the one or more objects, based on image data obtained by imaging by the imaging device, and a projection device that projects the sorting information generated by the provided information generating device onto the one or more objects.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Information processing system and information processing method
abstract: To provide an information processing system and an information processing method for accurately detecting whether or not a target event occurs without complicated condition setting.SOLUTION: In an information processing system 1, a center device includes a first generation unit for inputting a reference image in which a monitoring area is imaged in a state where a target event does not occur in the monitoring area to a first generation AI, and causing the first generation AI to generate reference text information describing a context shown in the reference image, a second generation unit for inputting a target image in which the monitoring area is imaged to a second generation AI, and causing the second generation AI to generate target text information describing the context shown in the target image, a third generation AI for inputting information on the reference text information, information on the target text information, and information on the target event to the third generation AI, and causing the third generation AI to generate determination result text information indicating whether or not the target event is included in the target image, and an output control unit for outputting information on a determination result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Image processing method, image processing system, and program
abstract: To provide an image processing system, an image processing method, and a program that improve convenience of a performance image.SOLUTION: In a performance analysis system connected with a keyboard instrument by wire or wirelessly and having a control device, a storage device, a scanning device, a display device, and an imaging device, image extraction processing includes region estimation processing Sb1 and region extraction processing Sb2. The region estimation processing Sb1 estimates a specific region for a performance image represented by image data. The specific region includes a keyboard image and a finger image in the performance image. When the control device executes the region estimation processing Sb1, an element (a region estimation unit) that estimates the specific region of the performance image is achieved. The region extraction processing Sb2 extracts a specific region from the performance image represented by image data. When the control device executes the region extraction processing Sb2, an element (a region extraction unit) that extracts the specific region of the performance image is achieved.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title: Image formation apparatus and processing method
abstract: To provide an image formation apparatus which improves the convenience of setting.SOLUTION: An image formation apparatus 100-A includes a communication unit 110-A which communicates with another image formation apparatus 100-B via a network and a processing unit 120-A. The processing unit 120-A provides a setting screen, when the setting of the image formation apparatus 100-A is received in the setting screen, reflects the setting on the image formation apparatus 100-A, and reflects the setting reflected on the image formation apparatus 100-A on the other image formation apparatus 100-B.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Liquified hydrogen transfer system and intermediate transfer facility and purge method of the same
abstract: To enable gas exhaustion through a vent line to be properly performed in a system which transfers liquified hydrogen.SOLUTION: A liquefied hydrogen transfer system TS1 comprises: a first facility 1 including a first tank 11 capable of storing liquefied hydrogen; a second facility 2 including a second tank 21 capable of storing the liquefied hydrogen; and an intermediate transfer facility 3 disposed between the first facility 1 and the second facility 2. The intermediate transfer facility 3 includes a transfer line 4 that transfers the liquefied hydrogen between the first tank 11 and the second tank 21, a purge line 5 that supplies purge gas to the transfer line 4, a vent line 6 that exhausts gas containing the purge gas from the transfer line 4, a branch line 7 that branches from the vent line 6 and merges with the vent line 6 at a downstream position in an exhaust direction with respect to a position of the branch, and a thermometer 8 that is disposed in the branch line 7 and measures the temperature of the gas flowing through the branch line 7.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Compact recirculation region of a recirculation fuel cell device
abstract: The present invention relates to a dehumidifier (10). The dehumidifier (10) has a housing (20), and the dehumidifier (10) has, within the housing (20), at least one first heat exchanger (30) and at least one second heat exchanger. The at least one first heat exchanger (30) is disposed below the at least one second heat exchanger. The gas stream flows through the at least one first heat exchanger (30) from bottom to top. The gas stream flows through the at least one second heat exchanger from bottom to top. The at least one first heat exchanger (30) cools the gas stream. The at least one second heat exchanger heats the gas stream. A water reservoir (50) is disposed below the at least one first heat exchanger (30) in the housing (20).

title: Valve Unit
abstract: To provide a valve unit to be applied to a refrigeration cycle, capable of reducing energy loss.SOLUTION: A valve unit 1 includes: a first member 12 having a first flow path 141 constituting a high temperature passage connecting a compressor 102 to a radiator 104; a second member 14 having a second flow path 142 including an expansion part of an expansion device 2 and constituting a medium temperature passage connecting the radiator 104 to the expansion part; and a third flow path 143 constituting a low temperature passage connecting the expansion part to the vaporizer 106; and a third member 16 to which the first member 12 and the second member 14 are each fixed so that the first member 12 and the second member 14 are in no direct contact with each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: drive unit
abstract: To provide a new drive unit and a new electric vehicle.SOLUTION: A drive unit 20 includes an electric machine 30 and a cooling system 50. A stator housing of the electric machine includes a stator housing inlet 41 and a stator housing outlet 42. The cooling system includes a first cooling circuit 51 connected to the stator housing inlet and outlet. Further, the first cooling circuit includes an expansion tank assembly 60. The expansion tank assembly includes an expansion tank 62, at least one expansion tank inlet 65, one expansion tank outlet 66, and a pressure equalization assembly 64. The expansion tank is connected to the first cooling circuit. The pressure equalization assembly 64 enables at least a temporal fluid connection between the expansion tank and an ambient environment 61 of the drive unit in order to cause a pressure equalization at least partially between the expansion tank and the ambient environment.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: compressible fluid plant
abstract: To provide a compressible fluid plant capable of transferring electrical energy from a storage battery to an apparatus to heat compressible fluid.SOLUTION: A compressible fluid plant 1 comprises: an apparatus 2 to heat compressible fluid; a turbine 4 capable of generating kinetic energy through interaction with the fluid; first electrical transformation means 5 to transform at least a first portion of the kinetic energy to electrical energy; a current storage battery 6 configured to store the electrical energy; a motor 3 in fluid passage connection with the turbine 4; and an electronic control unit 7 operably connected to the storage battery 6 so as to enable transferring the electrical energy from the storage battery 6. The storage battery 6 is operably connected to the apparatus 2 to transfer the electrical energy from the storage battery 6 to the apparatus 2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Resin composition, sheet-like laminate material, printed wiring board, and semiconductor device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a resin composition providing a cured article having low dielectric loss tangent, high mechanical strength, and high adhesiveness. SOLUTION: There is provided a resin composition containing (A) a resin having a thermosetting functional group FA, (B) a resin having a radical polymerizable functional group FB, and (C) a resin having a functional group FA' reactive with the thermosetting functional group FA and a functional group FB' reactive with the radical polymerizable functional group FB, and the number n a of the functional group FA' of the (C) component when the number of the thermosetting functional group FA of the (A) component is 1, and the number n b of the functional group FB' of the (C) component when the number of the radical polymerizable functional group FB of the (B) component is 1, satisfy 0.01≤n a ≤200 and 0.01≤n b ≤400. title: Laminate, printed matter, aqueous dispersion liquid, and laminate manufacturing method
abstract: The present invention provides a layered product comprising a release layer that can be formed from an aqueous coating liquid, that is quickly released from the substrate when alkaline treatment is performed, and that has excellent water resistance. The layered product of the present invention is a layered product comprising a release layer on a substrate, the release layer comprising a granular carboxylic anhydride-modified olefin resin and a binding part containing an acid group-free thermoplastic resin, the carboxylic anhydride-modified olefin resin having an average particle size of 0.5 to 20 μm, the binding part having a thickness of 0.25 to 20 μm, and the release layer having an actual acid value of 100 mg KOH/m 2 or more.

title: Negative photosensitive resin composition, method for forming pattern, interlayer insulation film, surface protection film, and electronic component
abstract: To provide a negative photosensitive resin composition that gives high resolution, has excellent characteristics such as mechanical strength and adhesion, and also excels in storage stability.SOLUTION: A negative photosensitive resin composition comprises: (A) one or more selected from a polyimide structure, a polyamide structure, a polybenzoxazole structure, a polyamide imide structure, and precursor structures thereof, (B) a photoacid generator, (C) one or more crosslinking agents selected from an amino condensate modified with formaldehyde or formaldehyde-alcohol, a phenol compound having, on average, two or more methylol groups or alkoxymethylol groups in one molecule, a compound in which a hydrogen atom of a hydroxyl group of polyvalent phenol is substituted with a glycidyl group or a group having the glycidyl group, a compound in which a hydrogen atom of a hydroxyl group of the polyvalent phenol is substituted with a substituent represented by a glycidyl group derivative, and a compound containing two or more nitrogen atoms having a glycidyl group derivative, (D) an onium salt, and (E) a solvent.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Composition having improved storage stability
abstract: To provide a resin composition for a two-liquid component type curable resin composition having good storage stability under high temperature and high humidity environment.SOLUTION: A resin composition for a two-liquid component type curable resin composition contains 100 pts.wt. of (A) a polyoxyalkylene-based polymer (A), 10-400 pts.wt. of surface-treated calcium carbonate having a specific structure, and 2-70 pts.wt. of (C) an epoxy compound.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Curable resin and method for producing the same, curable resin composition and cured product
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cured product having heat resistance and excellent dielectric characteristics (low dielectric characteristics) using a curable resin having a specific structure and to provide a method for producing the curable resin. SOLUTION: There is used a production method in which an aralkyl compound represented by the general formula (3-1) or the general formula (3-2), a phenol represented by the general formula (4) or a derivative thereof, one aralkyl compound and one crosslinking group-introducing agent selected from the group consisting of anhydrous acrylic acid, anhydrous methacrylic acid, acrylic acid chloride, methacrylic acid chloride, chloromethylstyrene, chlorostyrene, allyl chloride and allyl bromide are reacted. title: Method for producing four-season meju with lactic acid bacteria and beneficial bacteria that reduces the harmful factors of traditional soybean paste
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing lactic acid bacteria (beneficial bacteria) four-season fermented soybean lump reducing risk factors in traditional fermented sauces realized with: a raw material and auxiliary raw material bringing-in step; a selection and washing step; an immersion step; a steaming step; a starter inoculation step; a grinding step; a compression and molding step; a fermentation step; and a drying step, wherein the manufactured four-season fermented soybean lump have a remarkable effect of developing the traditional fermented soybean lumps industry into a competitive industry by making the allowable range of apratoxin and biogenic amine, which are risk factors, meet domestic and international standards.

title: Recombinant components and compositions for use in food products
abstract: To provide methods for use in producing alternatives to animal-derived food products from recombinant components, as well as compositions used in and obtained from such methods.SOLUTION: Provided are methods for producing food products comprising recombinant components, and compositions used in and food products produced by such methods.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Feed for marine invertebrates and method for producing feed for marine invertebrates
abstract: To provide a feed for marine invertebrates such as abalones and urchins, and to provide a method for producing the feed for marine invertebrates.SOLUTION: Provided are a feed for marine invertebrates, characterized by containing algae powders and food processing residues; and a method for producing the feed for marine invertebrates, characterized by performing a solidification step of solidifying algae powders and food processing residues.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5D

title: A Manufacturing Method of Cheonggukjang Mixed with Aquilaria Agallocha
abstract: The present invention relates to functional Cheonggukjang (fast-fermented bean paste) using aloeswood leaves and a method for preparing the same. More specifically, the present invention has been described step by step. The present invention comprises: a first step of cleanly washing soybeans from which foreign substances are removed and immersing the soybeans in water at a temperature of 15-30℃ for 10-14 hours; a second step (roasting step) of roasting aloeswood leaves that have been dried and washed with water at a temperature of 130-170℃; a third step (grinding step) of grinding the roasted aloeswood leaves into powder; a fourth step (mixing step) of mixing the soaked soybeans with the aloeswood leaf powder at a weight ratio of 10:0.1-3.0; and a fifth step of mixing the mixture ingredients thereof with rice straw or inoculating the mixture ingredients with Bacillus subtilis and fermenting the mixture ingredients in a fermentation chamber for 48-72 hours. Accordingly, the preparation method of the present invention has the effects of: providing functional Cheonggukjang using aloeswood leaves, which is obtained by suppressing unique strong and unpleasant odor and taste of Cheonggukjang; increasing the unique scent of aloeswood; adding the unique efficacy of Cheonggukjang and the efficacy of aloeswood leaves so that Cheonggukjang can be provided as food which can be consumed by men and women of all ages without any repulsion; and maximizing advantages of Cheonggukjang by the combination of the unique efficacy of Cheonggukjang with the efficacy of aloeswood leaves. In particular, Cheonggukjang of the present invention can be used as a local specialty, and thus, it is expected that the present invention will increase farm income, create jobs, and further contribute to an increase in export.

title: Heated seasoning composition
abstract: To provide a seasoning composition that can be substituted for beef extract and can be widely applied to plant foods.SOLUTION: This purpose is achieved with: a heated seasoning composition including a plant protein decomposition product, a carbohydrate, a vegetable extract, and a plant oil/fat, where the pH is 4.50 or more, and the combined quantity of the plant protein decomposition product, the carbohydrate and the vegetable extract is 60 wt.% or more of the total quantity; a plant food manufacturing method including a step for obtaining the plant food by cooking using a plant-derived ingredient and a heated seasoning composition which includes a plant protein decomposition product, a carbohydrate, a vegetable extract, and a plant oil/fat, and has a pH of 4.50 or more, where the combined quantity of the plant protein decomposition product, the carbohydrate and the vegetable extract is 60 wt.% or more of the total quantity.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Semiconductor device and semiconductor device manufacturing method
abstract: To provide a semiconductor device for performing high-performance active operation and a semiconductor device manufacturing method that can easily manufacture the semiconductor device.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device (electromagnetic wave detection device) includes a substrate 11, an active element (rectifying element 12) which is formed on the substrate, has a semiconductor layer and a first element end and a second element end, and performs an active operation between the first element end and the second element end, a first electrode (cathode electrode 13) which is formed on the substrate and connected to the first element end of the active element, a second electrode (anode electrode 14) formed on the substrate away from the active element, a support rod 18 which is formed on a region between the active element and the second electrode on the substrate, and made of the same semiconductor material as the semiconductor layer of the active element, and a wiring portion 17 which is supported by the support rod and is bridged and wired between the second element end of the active element and the second electrode while passing through the support rod.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Semiconductor device manufacturing method, semiconductor device, and semiconductor apparatus
abstract: A manufacturing method for a semiconductor device according to the present disclosure includes preparing a laminate body 10 including a plurality of semiconductor layers 11, 12, and 13, and a first support body 20 including an upper surface 20a, a side surface 20b, and a recessed portion 21 including an opening adjacent to the upper surface 20a and the side surface 20b, bonding and disposing the laminate body 10 to the upper surface 20a of the first support body 20, forming a first end surface 10a at the laminate body 10, and forming a first dielectric layer 17 on the first end surface 10a.

title: Transfer substrate, electronic device and manufacturing method of transfer substrate
abstract: To provide a transfer substrate capable of improving a yield, an electronic device and a manufacturing method of the transfer substrate.SOLUTION: A transfer substrate comprises: a substrate including a first top face; a conductive film which is provided on the substrate and includes a second top face; and a first insulator film which is provided on the substrate and directly in contact with the conductive film and includes a third top face continued to the second top face. The second top face and the third top face are tilted from the first top face in a boundary between the second top face and the third top face.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Semiconductor memory
abstract: To reduce lamination defects.SOLUTION: According to the embodiment, a semiconductor memory has a first chip 10 including a plurality of first wiring layers WL spaced and stacked in the first direction, a memory pillar MP extending in the first direction and passing through the plurality of first wiring layers, a second wiring layer BL electrically connected to the memory pillar, a first electrode 108 electrically connected to one of the plurality of first wiring layers and a second electrode 108 electrically connected to the second wiring layer, and a second chip 20 including a third electrode 210 bonded to the first electrode, and a fourth electrode 210 bonded to the second electrode. title: Electrical structure and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a substrate; a first insulation layer disposed over a first surface of the substrate; a second insulation layer disposed on the first insulation layer; and an electrical contact extending through the first and second insulation layers to electrically connect to the first surface of the substrate. The electrical contact includes a first portion disposed in the first insulation layer and a second portion disposed in the second insulation layer, the first portion has a first width, the second portion has a second width, and a ratio of a difference between the first width and the second width to the first width is less than 10%; at least one isolation feature extending into the substrate and disposed below the first surface of the substrate; and at least one conductive feature extending through the second insulation layer and the first insulation layer and into the substrate.

title: Performance assessment method of vehicle and automatic operation device
abstract: To enable, when a main body forming the travel plan for an automatic operation is independent from a main body controlling travel of the vehicle according to the travel plan, the main body controlling travel of a vehicle to grasp performance of the main body forming a travel plan.SOLUTION: A vehicle 2 comprises: a travel condition sensor 15 which acquires information about traveling state of the vehicle 2; a processor 100; and a memory 110 connected with the processor 100 which stores instructions 120 that are executable in the processor 100. The instruction 120 makes the processor 100 execute: communication with an automatic operation device 20 which calculates a target track of the vehicle 2; automatic travel of the vehicle based on the target track received from the automatic operation device 20; and calculation of evaluation value in performance of the automatic operation device 20 based on the information acquired by the travel condition sensor 15.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Information notification device, information notification system, and information notification method
abstract: To provide an information notification device that notifies an operator of information and is capable of further accurately providing notification with simple configuration.SOLUTION: An information notification device 100 includes: an operation state information acquisition unit 111 that acquires operation state information of a manufacturing device; and an operation determination unit 112 that determines an operation state of the manufacturing device. The information notification device 100 also includes a wireless signal information acquisition unit that acquires received power information indicating received power of a wireless signal transmitted from the manufacturing device to a portable terminal. The information notification device 100 also includes a position calculation unit 114 that calculates an operator distance from the manufacturing device to the operator based on the received power information. The information notification device 100 also includes a distance determination unit 115 that determines, based on the operator distance and a determination distance, a distance of the operator. The information notification device 100 further includes an abnormality information transmission unit 116 that transmits abnormality information to the portable terminal of the operator upon determination that the operator distance is greater than or equal to the determination distance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Safety verification system and safety verification method
abstract: To reduce a step number required for a safety design when expanding a traveling area of an autonomous appliance.SOLUTION: A safety verification system that verifies a safety of an autonomous appliance which drives autonomously in accordance with a safety rule, comprises: an environmental condition database that holds an environmental condition of a travel area; a safety rule database that holds the safety rule set by referring to the environmental condition; and a verification-required area extraction unit that extracts a verification-required area which requires safety verification from an additional travel area when the safety rule is applied in the additional travel area by comparing an environmental condition of the additional travel area with an environmental condition of an original travel area when expanding the travel area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: system
abstract: An object of the system according to the embodiment is to optimize an evacuation route at the time of a disaster and to dynamically provide guidance in multiple languages.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a collection unit, an analysis unit, a route generation unit, a guidance unit, and a support unit. The collection unit collects data from a sensor or a monitoring camera. The analysis unit analyzes the data collected by the collection unit. The route generation unit generates an evacuation route based on the data analyzed by the analysis unit. The guidance unit guides the evacuation route generated by the route generation unit. The support unit finds and rescues the person in need of support.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Processing system, processing device, processing method, and processing program
abstract: To provide a processing system that secures the accuracy of driving control.SOLUTION: A processor of a processing system that conducts processing related to driving control of a host mobile body, is configured to: predict an action transition Ta in which a host action Ah of the host mobile body and a target action At of a target mobile body 3 transition while branching via interaction; and evaluate the host action Ah applied to the host mobile body by driving control on the basis of a risk expectation value Er correlated to a risk level Lr estimated for each branch in the action transition Ta and a probability of occurrence Pr that the branch occurs.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: Solid oxide fuel cell and manufacturing method of them
abstract: To provide a solid oxide fuel cell capable of suppressing a cracking of an electrolyte layer while having a humidification atmosphere durability to a metal substrate, and provide a manufacturing method of them.SOLUTION: A solid oxide fuel cell comprises: a metal substrate having a penetration hole of a thickness direction; a porous-like porous metal layer that is provided onto the metal substrate and contains a metal as a main component; an anode that is provided onto the porous metal layer; and an electrolyte layer that is provided onto the anode. A Ni concentration in the porous metal layer is lower than that of the metal substrate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Colloid containing platinum group supported on microwave-treated carrier, colloid containing platinum group supported on sulfonated carbon carrier, colloid containing platinum group supported on water repellent-treated tin oxide carrier, and high concentration continuous synthetic method thereof
abstract: To provide a method for producing platinum group fine particles supported on a carbon carrier, which enables a sulfonation treatment of a carbon carrier and a water repellent treatment of an oxide carrier to be performed in a short time, enables a metal fine particle catalyst supported on a surface-modified carrier to be synthesized efficiently, improves characteristics of gas diffusion, hydrogen ion conduction, and water management in a solid polymer fuel cell, and reduces production cost.SOLUTION: Provided is a high-performance and inexpensive method for producing a metal fine particle catalyst supported on a surface-modified carrier, by which a sulfonation treatment of a carbon carrier and a water repellent treatment of an oxide carrier can be performed with high productivity by using a microwave continuous method and by appropriately selecting a solvent, reaction conditions, and microwave irradiation conditions.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Grignard reaction method and method for storing grignard reagent
abstract: To provide a method for efficiently carrying out a Grignard reaction while suppressing the crystal deposition of a Grignard reagent even at ≤ -20 °C.SOLUTION: In a solution containing a Grignard reagent, tetrahydrofuran, an aromatic hydrocarbon solvent and 1, 2-dimethoxyethane, the precipitation of crystals of the Grignard reagent can be suppressed at ≤ - 20 °C and the Grignard reaction can efficiently be carried out.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Composite body, catalytic ink, and method for manufacturing composite body
abstract: Provided is a composite body comprising molybdenum disulfide and molybdenum trioxide, in which the molybdenum disulfide contains a 3R crystal structure, the content of molybdenum in terms of a molybdenum trioxide (B) calculated from the molybdenum content determined by the XRF analysis of the composite body relative to the whole mass of the composite body is 5 to 90% by mass. Also provided is a catalytic ink comprising the composite body and a solvent. Also provided is a method for manufacturing the composite body, the method comprising a burning step for heating molybdenum trioxide at a temperature of 400 DEG C or lower in the presence of a sulfur source.

title: Metal nanopowder crushing device
abstract: A metal nanopowder crushing apparatus is provided to easily obtain metal nanopowder with high purity by crushing a metal ingot with an electrochemical method. According to one aspect of the present invention, a metal nanopowder crushing device comprises an electrolytic tank configured to accommodate an electrolyte therein and to obtain first metal powder by electrochemically crushing a metal ingot by receiving power. The electrolytic tank includes a metal crushing unit provided in the electrolytic tank, accommodating the metal ingot therein, and configured to obtain the first metal powder by electrochemically crushing the metal ingot according to power application.

title: Composite molding material
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a composite molding material (10) comprising a fibrous layer (12) and a graphitic material (14) applied to the fibrous layer (12) at one or more localised regions (R1, R2, R3, and R4) on a surface (16) of the fibrous layer (12). SOLUTION: In the composite molding material, the graphitic material (14) forms one or more islands on the surface of the fibrous layer. Each of the islands is surrounded by one or more areas of the fibrous material deficient in the graphitic material. SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1 COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title: Fixing device, and image forming apparatus including fixing device
abstract: To provide a fixing device that can prevent a reduction in image quality and a reduction in conveyance performance of a recording medium, while preventing breakage of foams of gap parts.SOLUTION: A fixing device comprises a rotating body to be heated, a pressure rotating body, and a heating unit. The pressure rotating body has a core grid and an elastic layer laminated on an outer peripheral surface of the core grid, and brings the elastic layer into pressure contact with the rotating body to be heated to form a fixing nip part between the rotating body to be heated and the pressure rotating body. The heating unit heats the rotating body to be heated. The fixing device applies heat and pressure to a recording medium passing through the fixing nip part to fuse and fix an unfixed toner image on the recording medium. The elastic layer has a plurality of gap parts. The plurality of gap parts are divided into single bubbles to be separated from each other, and a first length of the gap part along a radial direction of the pressure rotating body is four or more times a second length orthogonal to the radial direction and is 300 μm or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

The second resin substrate has a larger area than the laminate part and has an extension part extending from the outer edges of the first side, the apex and the second side at a corner part including a vertex where the first side and the second side of the first resin substrate orthogonally intersect. A length of the extension part extending from the first side in the first direction orthogonal to the first side is 5 to 20 mm, a length of the extension part in a direction parallel to the first side from an intersection of the extension part and the first side is 10 to 40 mm, a length of the extension part extending from the second side in the second direction orthogonal to the second side is 5 to 20 mm and a length of the extension part in a direction parallel to the second side from an intersection of the extension part and the second side is 10 to 40 mm.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Resin molded article

title: Interior sheet
abstract: To facilitate work of installing a cushioning material in a box body in a suspended state.SOLUTION: An interior sheet 5 assembled into an interior body installed in a box body includes: a sheet-like mount 6 in which two surface areas 61, 61 are located adjacent to each other in a lateral direction D2 through a breaking assist part 62 extending in a vertical direction D1 in a plan view; and a sheet-like cushioning material 7 which is overlapped with the mount 6 across the breaking assist part 62. title: Multispecific and multifunctional molecular and use of the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide used in cancer treatment. SOLUTION: A multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide includes: (i) a tumor targeting portion binding to cancer antigen, which is a first tumor targeting portion for example; (ii) an immunocyte engager selected from an NK-cell engager, a T-cell engager, a B-cell engager, a dendritic cell engager or a macrophage cell engager; (iii) cytokine molecules; and (iv) two or all of interstitial adjustment portions. title: Modular targeted therapeutic agents and methods of making same
abstract: Provided herein are methods for making targeted therapeutics. In several embodiments, the therapeutics are directed against soluble agents such as toxins, venoms, and/or other factors that alter physiological biopathways as well as methods of using such therapeutics to treat patients or patient populations to reduce, eliminate, or inactivate, detrimental soluble agents that such patients or patient populations have been exposed to. In several embodiments, the therapeutics are directed to patient-specific disease markers. In several embodiments, the methods comprise screening a library comprising proteins linked to their cognate mRNAs to identify mRNA-protein pairs that bind to the diseased cells, isolating one or more proteins from the identified mRNA-protein pairs, and conjugating the isolated protein(s) to a therapeutic agent.

title: Anti-her2 combinations for treating cancer
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a therapeutic combination for treating cancer by using combinational therapy. SOLUTION: A therapeutic combination comprises: (i) an effective amount of a Her2/Neu antagonist, such as an antibody or a functional fragment thereof that specifically binds to Her2/Neu (e.g., anti-Her2 antibody); and (ii) an effective amount of an immunotherapeutic that is capable of activating a human plasmacytoid dendritic cell, myeloid dendritic cell, or NK cell, or a combination thereof. title: Compositions and methods for treatment of kidney diseases
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide methods and compositions for increasing the expression of a protein, and for treating a subject in need thereof, e.g., a subject with deficient protein expression or a subject having a kidney disease. SOLUTION: Provided is a method comprising the step of contacting the cells of a subject with an antisense oligomer (ASO), which is complementary to the targeted portion of RIC pre-mRNA encoding a target protein or functional RNA, whereby the retained intron is constitutively spliced from the RIC pre-mRNA encoding the target protein or functional RNA, thereby increasing the level of mRNA encoding the target protein or functional RNA, and in the cells of the subject, increasing the expression of the target protein or functional RNA. title: Electrooptical device and electronic apparatus

The protective member abuts on a space formed between the protective member and at least one of the first lens part and the second lens part, and a maximum value of 5° specular reflectance spectrum is 1.2% or less at wavelength 420-680 nm.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Light-emitting device
abstract: To provide a display device in which deterioration of display quality is reduced even when the size is reduced by reducing visible light emitted by an infrared light emitting element from leaking light of adjacent pixels.SOLUTION: A light-emitting device according to the present disclosure includes a display element and an infrared light emitting element on an insulating layer, and includes reducing means that reduces light emitted from an infrared light emitting unit in the direction of the display element in a plan view from a direction perpendicular to the insulating layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Optical display media and articles
abstract: To provide an optical display medium with increased difficulty in reuse.SOLUTION: There is provided an optical display medium including a holding portion having a first translucent portion that can transmit light, a second translucent portion that can transmit light, a connection portion that connects the first translucent portion and the second translucent portion; and a display portion provided with a polarization separation layer having a polarization separation function. The first translucent portion, the connection portion, and the second translucent portion are continuously formed. The first translucent portion and the second translucent portion face each other. The display portion is provided between the first translucent portion and the second translucent portion. title: Electro-optical device and electronic apparatus
abstract: To provide an electro-optical device that can reduce the thickness of films for forming a plurality of lenses and improve the accuracy of the positions of the plurality of lenses, and an electronic apparatus.SOLUTION: A second substrate 20 of an electro-optical device 1 is provided with a first curved surface 510. title: Network device and processing method for network device
abstract: To allow the security of communication to be enhanced.SOLUTION: A network device includes: acquisition means that acquires proxy information set in the network device; and communication means that communicates with a management server via a proxy server using the proxy information if an aggregation mode is enabled and the proxy information is information received from the proxy server, or if the aggregation mode is not enabled, and that does not communicate with the management server if the aggregation mode is enabled and the proxy information is not information received from the proxy server.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 12

title: Image forming apparatus
abstract: To provide an image forming apparatus that can easily connect to a desired server among a plurality of partner servers.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus 10 comprises a reading unit 1, a communication unit 50, and a control unit 60. The reading unit 1 reads an input image of a business card or a staff identity card of a user. The communication unit 50 executes communication via a network 20. The control unit 60 controls the reading unit 1 and the communication unit 50. The control unit 60 specifies a desired partner server related to the user's post from among a plurality of partner servers 11-13 via the network 20 by using at least one of character information and image information based on the input image, and sets information for connection to the desired partner server to the communication unit 50.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Information processing device and program
abstract: To provide an information processing device and a related program capable of assisting in acquiring corporate information.SOLUTION: According to one aspect of the present invention, an information processing device includes a reception unit, an acquisition unit, an addition unit, and a management unit. The reception unit is configured to be able to receive an input of first corporate information. The acquisition unit is configured to be able to acquire second corporate information that can be acquired via the Internet. The addition unit is configured to be able to generate third corporate information in which the second corporate information is added to the first corporate information, in which the second corporate information is weighted according to an acquisition source of the second corporate information and included in the third corporate information. The management unit stores and manages the third corporate information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Information processing device and control program thereof

The acquisition means acquires a settlement code. The reception means accepts designation of a code settlement company. The notification means notifies users, when the code settlement company identified by a company identification code included in the settlement code acquired by the acquisition means does not match the code settlement company which accepted the designation by the reception means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: Injectivity improvement with thioalcohols
abstract: Thioalcohols are useful for dissolving and removing aldehyde-containing deposits from conduit and/or volumes that are clogged or blocked by the aldehyde-containing deposits, and also to prevent or inhibit aldehydes from polymerizing or otherwise forming aldehyde-containing deposits within conduits and/or volumes.

title: Analysis of measurements of a polymer
abstract: A time-ordered series of measurements of a polymer made during translocation of the polymer through a Nanopore are analysed. The measurements are dependent on the identity of k-mers in the Nanopore, a k-mer bring k polymer units of the polymer, where k is a positive integer. The method involves deriving, from the series of measurements, a feature vector of time-ordered features representing characteristics of the measurements; and determining similarity between the derived feature vector and at least one other feature vector.

title: Resuscitative care system for context sensitive guidance
abstract: A context sensitive guidance (CSG) system for providing clinical interventions to a patient in an emergency medical event includes a CSG engine, patient interface devices configured to generate signals indicative of patient physiologic data, and a display device configured to provide a CSG user interface and medical device(s) configured to couple to the patient interface devices, the CSG engine and the display device, receive the signals, generate the physiologic data from the signals, and send the physiologic data to the CSG engine and the display device, wherein the CSG engine is configured to receive and evaluate the physiologic data, identify a clinical intervention, and send an output based on the clinical intervention to the medical device(s) configured to perform at least one operation in response to the sent output.

title: Fuel container for a tabletop fire pit
abstract: The invention relates to a fuel container for a tabletop fire pit, the fuel container comprising a sponge (15) at the upper end, wherein the fuel container (7) is designed such that liquid fuel in the fuel container (7) is transported into the sponge (15). By means of a fuel container of this type, the flame of a tabletop fire pit can burn particularly evenly at the desired height. The invention also relates to a tabletop fire pit.

title: Three dimensional shaping apparatus and shaping method
abstract: To provide a three-dimensional shaping apparatus and a shaping method capable of improving shaping efficiency while improving shaping quality.SOLUTION: The three-dimensional shaping apparatus extrudes a shaping material to shape a three-dimensional shaped object. The three-dimensional shaping apparatus includes an extruder 3 that extrudes a shaping material, an imaging device 6 that images a discharge state of the shaping material discharged from the extruder 3, and a control device 7 that controls the extruder 3. The control device 7 includes an operation control unit 72 that controls the operation of the extruder in a predetermined operation pattern, an acquisition unit 73 that acquires the image data of the discharge state captured by the imaging device 6, and an adjustment unit 75 that adjusts the predetermined operation pattern based on the image data of the discharge state acquired by the acquisition unit 73. The operation control part 72 operates the extruder 3 in the operation pattern adjusted by the adjustment part 75.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4
